questions.question: At what time between 4 and 5 are the hands opposite each other?
questions.explanation: At 4:00 the minute hand is 120° behind the hour hand. To be 180° ahead of it, it must gain 300°, taking 300/5.5 = 54 6/11 minutes, so the time is 4:54 6/11.

questions.question: A clock loses 5 minutes every hour. It is set right at 12 noon. The true time when it shows 3 p.m. is closest to
questions.explanation: The clock runs at 55/60 of the true rate, so true elapsed time = 180 × 60/55 ≈ 196 minutes, about 3:16 p.m.

A watch gains 2 minutes every hour. It is set right at 6 a.m. At what true time will it show 6 p.m.?
questions.explanation: The watch runs at 62/60 of the true rate, so the true elapsed time is 720 × 60/62 ≈ 696.8 minutes ≈ 11 h 37 min, which is about 5:37 p.m.
